passage.text: Monday: Today I started my experiment: no phone after 8 p.m. for one week.
passage.reading: ˈmʌndeɪ: təˈdeɪ aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd maɪ ɪkˈspɛrɪmənt: ˈnoʊ ˈfoʊn ˈæftər ˈeɪt ˌpiːˈɛm fər ˈwʌn ˈwiːk.

passage.text: At eight o'clock, I switched off my phone and put it in my bag.
passage.reading: ət ˈeɪt əˈklɑːk, aɪ ˈswɪtʃt ˈɔːf maɪ ˈfoʊn ənd ˈpʊt ɪt ɪn maɪ ˈbæɡ.

passage.text: It was so hard! I kept wanting to check my notifications.
passage.reading: ɪt wʌz soʊ ˈhɑːrd! aɪ ˈkɛpt ˈwɑːntɪŋ tə ˈtʃɛk maɪ ˌnoʊtəfɪˈkeɪʃənz.

passage.text: Wednesday: I didn't realize how addictive my phone was until I stopped using it in the evening.
passage.reading: ˈwɛnzdeɪ: aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈriːəlaɪz ˈhaʊ əˈdɪktɪv maɪ ˈfoʊn wʌz ənˈtɪl aɪ ˈstɑːpt ˈjuːzɪŋ ɪt ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ.

passage.text: Tonight I read a book, and now I'm going to bed at ten thirty.
passage.reading: təˈnaɪt aɪ ˈrɛd ə ˈbʊk, ənd ˈnaʊ aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈbɛd ət ˈtɛn ˈθɜːrti.

passage.text: I can't remember the last time I went to bed this early!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈkænt rɪˈmɛmbər ðə ˈlæst ˈtaɪm aɪ ˈwɛnt tə ˈbɛd ˈðɪs ˈɜːrli!

passage.text: Friday: My screen-free evenings are getting easier.
passage.reading: ˈfraɪdeɪ: maɪ ˌskriːn ˈfriː ˈiːvnɪŋz ər ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈiːziər.

passage.text: My roommate and I have started cooking dinner together, and we talk a lot more.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈruːmmeɪt ənd aɪ hæv ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈkʊkɪŋ ˈdɪnər təˈɡɛðər, ənd wiː ˈtɔːk ə ˈlɑːt ˈmɔːr.

passage.text: But my manager was annoyed, because I didn't answer his email at nine.
passage.reading: bʌt maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər wʌz əˈnɔɪd, bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈænsər hɪz ˈiːmeɪl ət ˈnaɪn.

passage.text: So today I explained my experiment to him.
passage.reading: soʊ təˈdeɪ aɪ ɪkˈspleɪnd maɪ ɪkˈspɛrɪmənt tə hɪm.

passage.text: Sunday: The week is over, and I feel more rested than I have in months.
passage.reading: ˈsʌndeɪ: ðə ˈwiːk ɪz ˈoʊvər, ənd aɪ ˈfiːl ˈmɔːr ˈrɛstɪd ðən aɪ ˈhæv ɪn ˈmʌnθs.

passage.text: I sleep better, and I don't wake up at night to check messages.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈsliːp ˈbɛtər, ənd aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈweɪk ˈʌp ət ˈnaɪt tə ˈtʃɛk ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz.

passage.text: My manager said I can switch off after eight, as long as I answer urgent emails in the morning.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər ˈsɛd aɪ kən ˈswɪtʃ ˈɔːf ˈæftər ˈeɪt, əz ˈlɔːŋ əz aɪ ˈænsər ˈɜːrdʒənt ˈiːmeɪlz ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: I think I'll keep my screen-free evenings.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪl ˈkiːp maɪ ˌskriːn ˈfriː ˈiːvnɪŋz.

passage.text: Maybe next month, I'll try a screen-free weekend!
passage.reading: ˈmeɪbi ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ, aɪl ˈtraɪ ə ˌskriːn ˈfriː ˈwiːkɛnd!
